prompt: A fail-closed webhook blocks writes while custom-resource deletions are stuck. Lead recovery.
directAnswer: Declare API-write and lifecycle impact; freeze policy edits. Bind webhook configuration/request UIDs, matching rules, selectors, TLS endpoint, timeout/failure policy, CR UIDs, deletion timestamps, finalizers and external resources. Restore the endpoint or use reviewed narrow break-glass while preserving required control. Restore the finalizer owner and prove external cleanup before removal. Verify allowed and denied admission, API latency, deletions, absence, user operation and audit trail.
foundation: Admission availability and finalizer cleanup are separate control-plane incidents.
seniorAnswer: I run two evidence streams and do not trade a cluster-wide security bypass for availability.
weakAnswer: Delete all webhooks and patch out finalizers.
